findings.title: Register resource ownership immediately after each allocation
findings.finding: Second CreatePipe failure leaks the first pipe pair; second output-handle duplication failure leaks the first duplicated writer. Append each successful handle before the next fallible API.

findings.title: Do not skip cleanup on termination or wait errors
findings.finding: TerminateJobObject failure returns before exact-root waits; any exception from WaitForSingleObject/GetExitCodeProcess/accounting inside _shutdown skips _close_owned and reader joins, because its enclosing finally only closes the job. Default explicit policy may leave unproven live processes and leaks handles.

findings.title: Reader transfer ownership is not exception safe
findings.finding: If first reader starts and second thread creation/start fails, reads still contains both handles and _spawn finally closes them while first reader owns and later closes the same handle. Explicit transferred ownership per reader is needed.

findings.title: Reader failures and cancellation can falsely complete
findings.finding: Read OSError is swallowed without a failure indicator, bad_read is never checked, and close failures mark closed=True. Cancellation/deadline arriving during sequential reader joins is not rechecked before PROCESS_COMPLETED. Check all reader errors and recheck cancellation/deadline after joins.

findings.title: Last launch can exceed startup budget or resume after cancellation
findings.finding: Budgets/cancel checked only before _spawn, not inside it before ResumeThread or after the final spawn. A single slow spawn exceeding startup_seconds is admitted if under whole deadline.

findings.title: Aggregate log cap repair is present but identifiers remain unbounded
findings.finding: Logs are safely externalized if inline JSON exceeds 128 KiB, but run/worker identifiers have no length limit and can make filenames invalid or receipt still oversized. An emit exception occurs after handle closure and returns no terminal receipt.

findings.title: Capacity is planned rather than demonstrated
findings.finding: assigned_bytes is never tied to highwater or actual resident weight/KV/activation bytes; no multi/four-card parity-success receipt, completed kernels or resident ownership are required by _capacity. highwater=0 and all kernel/block evidence removed can still qualify standalone capacity.

findings.title: Four-required capacity can qualify with only three devices
findings.finding: _capacity requires only two dedicated devices; need_three merely checks a three-device OOM label. Three devices with fitting aggregate plans and a three-device OOM can qualify FOUR_REQUIRED_CAPACITY without any fourth device or four-device success.

findings.title: Control artifact is not bound to the compared computation
findings.finding: _good_control checks kind/scope/exit/detected/hash only. It ignores model/workload/build/executable, physical IDs, tensor dimensions, timestamps and numerical differences. A trusted control from a different workload is accepted.

findings.title: Numerical claims can omit actual GPU execution
findings.finding: _two accepts CPU or OTHER device_class if vendors differ and kernel.completed is True. _llm never checks participating physical IDs or GPU kernels at all; it can qualify with devices=[] and numeric/prose operator labels. Kernel tensor/weight artifacts are not bound to claimed model/workload execution.

findings.title: Predeclared tolerances and metric consistency are optional
findings.finding: Predeclared tolerances are checked only when supplied. Removing them allows arbitrary loose atol/rtol. rmse>max_abs_error is not rejected. max_abs_error<=atol also ignores legitimate relative tolerance, so rejection semantics do not implement documented atol+rtol parity.

findings.title: P2P and durable evidence are not fully bound
findings.finding: P2P lacks matching model/workload/build/executable, full count/reference digests/tolerance and GPU-only participants. Durable events are hash labels only: no event checkpoint/sequence/workload binding, order, freshness or replay-boundary relation. Unrelated trusted event sets can qualify.

findings.title: Usable budget need not follow measured free
findings.finding: Memory allows free_bytes=0 with usable_bytes>0 as long as usable+reserve<=total. Source label ACTUAL_ALLOCATOR has no per-measurement artifact binding; current memory freshness alone does not establish actual residency.

findings.title: Strict schema and unknown handling incomplete
findings.finding: schema=True passes ==1; PCI match with $ admits a trailing newline; missing PCI returns REFUSED instead of NOT_CHECKED. Unhashable physical_ids in _oom raise TypeError and non-string dict keys can raise in _collect_shas instead of structured refusal.

findings.title: Pure supervisor tests contain independent failures
findings.finding: Import-safety textual test sees WinDLL in docstring. Constant (b"abc",0) read fills beyond cap and cannot satisfy expected single abc/no overflow. Two-value monotonic iterator exhausts during _shutdown, skipping cleanup. FakeAPI pipe handle pairs can overlap, so ownership tests are not reliable.

findings.title: Validator negative tests can be masked and positive fixture omits required proof
findings.finding: Several tests omit device weight/tensor hashes from trusted/listed artifacts and therefore hit trust rejection before memory/PCI/numerical guards. Claimed valid capacity fixture has only 1024-byte highwater for 2 GB assignments and no four-device numerical pass; passing it would encode the false-positive architecture.

discriminating_cases.name: second_pipe_failure
discriminating_cases.setup: First CreatePipe returns distinct owned handles; second raises OSError.
discriminating_cases.assertion: Both first-pair handles closed exactly once; no process launched; no handle left ownerless.

discriminating_cases.name: second_duplicate_failure
discriminating_cases.setup: stdout DuplicateHandle succeeds; stderr DuplicateHandle raises.
discriminating_cases.assertion: All originals and successful duplicate closed once.

discriminating_cases.name: terminate_job_failure_and_wait_exception
discriminating_cases.setup: Two owned roots, first assigned and second unassigned suspended. TerminateJobObject returns false; alternatively one exact-root wait raises.
discriminating_cases.assertion: Every root is still independently waited/terminated within common bound; all handles closed in exception-safe finally; drain UNKNOWN if any proof missing.

discriminating_cases.name: second_reader_start_failure
discriminating_cases.setup: First fake reader takes ownership; second start raises.
discriminating_cases.assertion: First read handle never closed by two owners; worker/job terminated and reader cancellation/join bounded.

discriminating_cases.name: cancel_during_join
discriminating_cases.setup: Roots signaled and job empty; cancel event changes to set during reader join.

discriminating_cases.name: no_actual_residency_capacity
discriminating_cases.setup: Start with fully trusted schema-valid capacity fixture; highwater=0, remove every kernel/block, keep fitting assigned_bytes and labeled single/three OOM.
discriminating_cases.assertion: NOT_CHECKED or REFUSED with no capacity qualified claims.

discriminating_cases.name: three_devices_cannot_prove_four
discriminating_cases.setup: Only p1,p2,p3, each usable6GB; requirement8GB; assigned3GB/3GB/2GB; bound single OOM and three OOM; no fourth success.

discriminating_cases.name: mismatched_control
discriminating_cases.setup: Otherwise valid two-vendor numerical fixture; control model/workload hashes differ, both old and new artifacts externally trusted.

discriminating_cases.name: cpu_only_two_vendor_and_llm
discriminating_cases.setup: Two CPU participants with differing vendors and completed kernel labels; separately valid llm scalar summary with devices=[] and unrelated comparator control.
discriminating_cases.assertion: No actual GPU numerical claim qualified.

discriminating_cases.name: missing_predeclared_and_inconsistent_metrics
discriminating_cases.setup: Remove predeclared tolerances, set atol1e6; separately rmse1e-5,max_abs_error0 with zero violations.
discriminating_cases.assertion: Unknown tolerance declaration or contradictory metric refused/not checked.

discriminating_cases.name: unrelated_durability_events
discriminating_cases.setup: Trusted WORKER_LOSS/CANCEL/RESTART artifacts belonging to distinct model/checkpoint sequences, while aggregate summary says COMPLETE.
discriminating_cases.assertion: Cannot qualify replay by event kind set.

evidence_trust_limit: External trusted hashes can bind caller-admitted artifacts; membership cannot authenticate arbitrary JSON claims or associate unrelated events. No synthetic fixture is physical hardware evidence.
